integrity.scope: deterministic synchronous timed non-progressive threshold adoption

scientific_limitations: General even-cost theorem assumes finite bipartite graphs and strictly positive feasible thresholds.
Count-state algorithm requires a complete bipartite graph and equal unit cost per vertex-time intervention.

The alternating-part parity technique is related to the 2023 source proof of its double-cover theorem; priority is asserted only for the combined precise biclique computation, not basic parity splitting.
No independent audit or external formal validation has been performed.
title: Even intervention budgets and exact heterogeneous-biclique timed targeting
